==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|trade mark|trade-mark}}

===Etymology===
From {{com|en|trade|mark}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɹeɪdmɑːk/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɹeɪdmɑɹk/|a=GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-trademark.ogg|a=California}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Samuel Muldoon (Muldoonsamuel55)-trademark.wav|a=Aurora,Colorado}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɹæɪdmɐːk/|a=AU,NZ}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪdmɑː(ɹ)k|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|trade|mark}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|identification of a company's product}}A [[word]], [[symbol]], or [[phrase]] used to identify a particular company's product and differentiate it from other companies' products.
#: {{ant|en|generic name|;|description}}
#: {{cot|en|brandname|brand name|service mark|tradename|trade name|wordmark}}
## Especially, such a term that is [[registered]] with a government agency so as to have legal protection against use by other companies.
# Any proprietary business, product or service name.
#* {{quote-book|en|title=The Internet, the Web, and eBusiness|page=xv|author=Kai A. Olsen|year=2005|passage='''Trademark''' Notice / The following are '''trademarks''' or registered '''trademarks''' of their respective companies: {{...}} Google is a '''trademark''' of Google Corporation; eBay is a '''trademark''' of eBay, Inc.}}
# The aspect for which someone or something is best known; a [[hallmark]] or typical characteristic.

{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|proscribed}} To [[register]] something as a [[#Noun|trademark]].
# {{lb|en|transitive|proscribed}} To so [[label]] a product.

====Usage notes====
* Among practitioners of trademark law, it is generally considered incorrect to use “trademark” as a verb; the preferred terminology would be to ''use a trademark'' or to ''register a trademark''.
